notes: Western business dress is required. The site has a scholarship page.
name: MSU Model United Nations Conference (MSUMUN)
org: Michigan State University Model United Nations
what_you_do: Play the part of a country in a committee. Practice debate, teamwork and writing official papers. MSU students run the event.
who_can_apply: High school students. Most sign up with a school team and an adviser.
pay_detail: Fees are in the Pre-Conference Advisor Guide and were not stated on the pages read.
deadline_text: MSUMUN XXVI is March 19 to 21, 2027 at the MSU Union. The register page shows a REGISTER NOW button. No closing date was shown on the pages read.
how_to_apply: Your school adviser signs you up on the Register page. Email executive@msumun.org with questions.
